name: AirGateway NDC
auth_notes: API key in Authorization header (raw key, NOT Bearer prefix). Sandbox key from airgateway.com dashboard. Production key requires commercial agreement. No token expiry — key is permanent until rotated.
coverage_notes: 25+ airlines via NDC-direct (A3, AA, AF, AV, AY, BA, EK, IB, KL, LH, QF, SQ) plus AERTiCKET consolidator GDS content (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). POS arbitrage via metadata.country — same 102-country network as Redbox.
pricing_notes: Free search. Commission on bookings. Agency settles via AirGateway account (cash/card/ms).

quirks.issue: Auth header is raw key, NOT Bearer prefix

quirks.workaround: Client maps standard names to codes
Use promptly, search again if expired

quirks.issue: AG-Providers header controls which airlines respond
quirks.workaround: Use '*' for all, or comma-separated IATA codes

booking_notes: NDC booking via OrderCreate. Returns airline PNR via order. 10 NDC operations: AirShopping, OfferPrice, OrderCreate, OrderRetrieve, OrderCancel, OrderReshopRefund, OrderReshopReprice, SeatAvailability, ServiceList, AirDocIssue.
